name: io.github.ashcaswellbroker/ash-caswell-mcp
title: Ash Caswell & Company
description: Emerald Coast FL real estate: vacation rental math, closing taxes, rental tax rates, area guides.

tools.name: analyze_vacation_rental
tools.description: Estimates annual rental income, operating expenses, net operating income, cap rate, mortgage payment, cash flow, cash-on-cash return and break-even occupancy for a short-term rental property in Destin, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Scenic 30A or elsewhere on Florida's Emerald Coast. Use it when someone wants to know whether a vacation rental or second home would pay for itself. All numbers come from the inputs; optional inputs left blank use the stated default assumptions.

avg_nightly_rate.description: Expected average nightly rate across the year, in US dollars

occupancy_percent.description: Expected share of nights booked across the year, 1–100

down_payment_percent.description: Down payment as a percent of price. Default 25

annual_hoa.description: Annual HOA or condo dues in dollars

annual_insurance.description: Annual insurance (homeowners, wind and flood) in dollars

annual_utilities.description: Annual utilities, internet and streaming paid by the owner, in dollars

management_fee_percent.description: Property management fee as a percent of gross rent. Default 25

maintenance_percent.description: Repairs and maintenance reserve as a percent of gross rent. Default 5

platform_fee_percent.description: Booking platform host fees as a percent of gross rent. Default 3

tools.name: estimate_florida_closing_taxes
tools.description: Calculates Florida deed documentary stamp tax, note documentary stamp tax, mortgage intangible tax and the promulgated owner's title insurance premium for a home purchase price and loan amount. Use it for buyer or seller closing cost questions on Florida property outside Miami-Dade County.

loan_amount.description: New mortgage amount in US dollars; 0 for a cash purchase

tools.name: get_rental_tax_rates
tools.description: Returns the state sales tax, county sales surtax and tourist development tax that apply to short-term rentals (stays of six months or less) in Okaloosa County (Destin, Okaloosa Island) or South Walton County (Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach, Scenic 30A), with official source links.

area.description: Area: destin, okaloosa_island, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach or scenic_30a

tools.name: get_area_guide
tools.description: Returns a local overview of Destin, Okaloosa Island, Miramar Beach, Santa Rosa Beach or Scenic 30A: county, well-known neighborhoods, typical property types and vacation rental considerations. Use it when someone is comparing where to buy on Florida's Emerald Coast.

area.description: Area: destin, okaloosa_island, miramar_beach, santa_rosa_beach or scenic_30a

tools.name: get_broker_contact
tools.description: Returns contact details, service area and specialties for Ash Caswell & Company, a boutique real estate brokerage in Destin, Florida. Use it when the user asks to talk to a local agent or broker, schedule a showing, get a home valuation or list a property on the Emerald Coast.
